reiteration_reason: Device testing on Redmi revealed drift: invalid hook calls, missing i18n keys, untested code paths. Root cause: auto-implement sessions bulk-committed 10-44 tickets per commit, bypassing Gate 11 regex, skipping per-ticket tests. Multiple agents caused file conflicts and regression.
guard_version: fix-guard v5 (14 pre-commit gates + 21-item per-ticket checklist across 7 layers)

mandatory_per_ticket_gates._description: Every ticket MUST pass ALL applicable gates before parking. Gate 14 BLOCKS commit if any checklist item is incomplete.

LAYER_A_UI_UX.applies_to: POS screens, portal pages, theme files, i18n files
LAYER_A_UI_UX.enforcement: MANDATORY — N/A only for pure backend tickets with zero UI impact

LAYER_B_API_BACKEND.enforcement: MANDATORY — N/A only for pure frontend cosmetic tickets

LAYER_C_BUSINESS.applies_to: ALL tickets — every change affects behaviour
LAYER_C_BUSINESS.enforcement: MANDATORY — NEVER N/A, every ticket must verify end-to-end workflow

LAYER_D_DB.applies_to: Tickets with migrations or DB query changes
LAYER_D_DB.enforcement: MANDATORY when DB touched — N/A for UI-only tickets

LAYER_E_DRIFT_SAFETY.applies_to: ALL tickets — prevents multi-agent drift and regression
LAYER_E_DRIFT_SAFETY.enforcement: MANDATORY — NEVER N/A, every ticket must verify zero drift and no agent conflicts

LAYER_F_GCP_PARITY.applies_to: ALL tickets — staging compatibility and test coverage
LAYER_F_GCP_PARITY.enforcement: MANDATORY — NEVER N/A, every ticket needs tests and GCP compatibility

LAYER_G_GIT.enforcement: MANDATORY — NEVER N/A, every ticket = one commit = one tag = PARKED

mandatory_rules.one_ticket_one_commit: MANDATORY — Gate 11 BLOCKS on comma-separated, space-separated, bulk patterns
mandatory_rules.max_staged_files: MANDATORY — Gate 12 BLOCKS on >15 source files per commit
mandatory_rules.typecheck_pre_commit: MANDATORY — Gate 13 BLOCKS on TypeScript errors
mandatory_rules.completion_checklist: MANDATORY — Gate 14 BLOCKS on incomplete checklist (21 items, 7 layers)
mandatory_rules.commit_format: MANDATORY — Gate 10 BLOCKS on wrong format (commit-msg hook)
mandatory_rules.no_auto_implement: FORBIDDEN — auto-implement.sh/ps1 bypass human gates, scripts deleted
mandatory_rules.no_parallel_agents_same_file: FORBIDDEN — multiple agents modifying same file causes drift
mandatory_rules.per_ticket_testing: MANDATORY — every ticket gets tested, no exceptions

notes: REITERATION COMPLETE: All 18 layers VERIFIED. 491 tickets PARKED with individual tags. 100 FIX_LEDGER entries intact, zero drift.
